item.travelersbackpack.auto_drink_upgrad: Drinks water and other drinks from the backbag on its own to quench thirst
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: Let listed drinks through (use a water bottle or pail for tank water)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_block_: Block listed drinks (use a water bottle or pail for tank water)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_always: Drink whenever the thirst bar is not full
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_half_h: Drink when at least half of the drink's thirst-quenching strength can be used
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_full_h: Drink only when all of the drink's thirst-quenching strength can be used
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: Let water of any cleanness through
